lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: It didn't collapse. It knelt. Like it was putting something down carefully.
lines.lens: Structural failure complete. The corruption is dissipating — black veins fading to grey, then nothing. Underneath: clean stone. It was always clean stone.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: The tightness in his chest releasing. Like a held breath, but not his.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The corruption. It just... let go. Like it was tired of holding on.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.monologue: He's kneeling by the sentinel's hand. Running his fingers along the carvings on its palm. Catalogue marks. It was indexing what it guarded.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: These marks. It was keeping a record of everything behind that archway. In its hands. It was still trying to do its job.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Area's clear. There's a storeroom through the arch — mostly collapsed, but some containers are intact.
lines.monologue: She's already been through the archway and back. She does this. Secures the space before anyone asks.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Lex. Whatever's in there, it's not going anywhere. Take a minute.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.lens: Pattern analysis: the dark veins didn't spread from outside. They originated from below — from the foundations. Something under the ruins is generating this.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: It came from below. From the foundations. Something underneath these ruins is producing the corruption. The sentinel was just the first thing it reached.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Then everything down here is at risk. Every archive, every record. Everything they left behind.
lines.monologue: He said it quietly. Not dramatic. Just the weight of a fact settling into place.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: He doesn't say: before it reaches something else that can't fight back. He doesn't have to.
